Infantry: Unarmed engineer. Harvest fields, construct buildings and recover 35% of a ground machine’s material cost from its wreck within 3 minutes. Dismantle wrecks into materials on-site.
步兵: 无武装工程师，可采集资源、建造建筑，并在残骸产生后 3 分钟内回收地面机械材料成本的 35%。现场拆解残骸，直接获得材料。

Infantry: Fast field infantry against infantry and light machines. Capture relays; recover at a ranger camp. Weak against armor.
步兵: 机动步兵，擅长对抗步兵与轻型机械，可占领中继站并在游骑兵营地恢复。对装甲较弱。

Infantry: Shielded autocannon against infantry and light machines. Short-range anti-air shares its reload. Avoid heavy armor.
步兵: 装甲机炮车，擅长对抗步兵与轻型机械。近程防空共用装填周期，应避开重甲。

Infantry: 12 m heavy cannon against armor. Fires without a preparation charge; lighter protection demands scouting and repair support.
步兵: 射程 12 米的反装甲重炮，无需蓄力即可射击。防护较轻，需要侦察与维修支援。

Infantry: Unarmed quadrotor with extended vision. Scout flanks and wreck sites before committing engineers.
步兵: 无武装四旋翼侦察机，视野广阔。派工程师行动前，先侦察侧翼与残骸区域。

Infantry: Mobile strike rotorcraft against ground and air targets. Avoid anti-air; return to a rotor pad for service.
步兵: 机动攻击旋翼机，可攻击地面与空中目标。避开防空火力，并返回旋翼机坪维修。

Infantry: Produces scrapper rigs, accepts harvested and salvaged materials, and supplies 8 power.
步兵: 生产拾荒工程车，接收采集与回收的材料，并提供 8 电力。

Infantry: Trains ridge rangers. Two infantry recovery slots within 5 m. Uses 3 power.
步兵: 训练山脊游骑兵，在 5 米内提供 2 个步兵恢复位置。消耗 3 电力。

Infantry: Supplies 12 power to keep production and research running.
步兵: 提供 12 电力，维持生产与研究。

Infantry: Fixed ground cannon; protect against infantry and aircraft. Uses 2 power.
步兵: 固定地面火炮，需要防范步兵与航空器。消耗 2 电力。

Infantry: Dedicated air defense that prioritizes aircraft. Ground damage: 33% (100% with Dual-purpose AA). Uses 2 power.
步兵: 优先攻击航空器的专职防空阵地。对地伤害为 33%，研究两用防空后提升至 100%。消耗 2 电力。

Infantry: Harvest materials and electronics. Construct your base.
步兵: 采集材料与电子元件，建造基地。

Infantry: Inexpensive troops against infantry and light machines; weak against heavy armor. Capture relays and recover at barracks.
步兵: 低成本步兵，擅长对抗步兵与轻型机械，对重甲较弱。可占领中继站并在兵营恢复。

Infantry: Frontline armor with a ground-only cannon. Use infantry screens and repair support; aircraft require another weapon.
步兵: 前线装甲，主炮仅攻击地面目标。需要步兵掩护与维修支援，防空须依靠其他武器。

Infantry: 12 m anti-armor railgun with a 0.75 s charge per shot. Ground targets only; protect it with a frontline screen.
步兵: 射程 12 米的反装甲轨道炮，每发蓄力 0.75 秒。仅攻击地面目标，需要前排保护。

Infantry: Repairs nearby allies while idle. Right-click an ally to follow and repair.
步兵: 空闲时维修附近友军；右键友方单位可跟随并维修。

Infantry: Autocannon against infantry and light machines; weaker against heavy armor. 8 m ground / 6.5 m anti-air, shared reload.
步兵: 机炮擅长对抗步兵与轻型机械，对重甲较弱。对地射程 8 米 / 防空 6.5 米，共用装填周期。
无武装侦察单位，拥有更远视野。

Infantry: Strike aircraft for ground raids and air combat. Avoid dedicated anti-air and return to an airfield for service.
步兵: 用于对地突袭与空战的攻击机。避开专职防空，返回机场维修。

Infantry: Produces engineer rovers. Receives harvested resources. Supplies 8 power.
步兵: 生产工程漫游车，接收采集资源，提供 8 电力。

Infantry: Trains rifle infantry. Two infantry recovery slots within 5 m. Uses 3 power.
步兵: 训练步枪步兵，在 5 米内提供 2 个步兵恢复位置。消耗 3 电力。

Infantry: Produces armor and support robots. Uses 6 power.
步兵: 生产装甲单位与支援机器人。消耗 6 电力。

Infantry: Supplies 12 power. Low power slows production and service buildings.
步兵: 提供 12 电力。电力不足会降低生产与支援设施效率。

Infantry: Two ground repair slots within 5 m. Does not stack with other repairs. Uses 3 power.
步兵: 在 5 米内提供 2 个地面维修工位，不与其他维修叠加。消耗 3 电力。

Infantry: Defensive cannon against ground targets; cannot engage aircraft. Uses 2 power.
步兵: 攻击地面目标的防御炮台，无法攻击航空器。消耗 2 电力。

Infantry: Missile air defense that prioritizes aircraft. Ground damage: 33% (100% with Dual-purpose AA). Uses 2 power.
步兵: 优先攻击航空器的导弹防空阵地。对地伤害为 33%，研究两用防空后提升至 100%。消耗 2 电力。

Infantry: Unarmed engineer: harvest materials and electronics, deliver to HQ and construct your base.
步兵: 无武装工程师，采集材料与电子元件、交付总部，并建造基地。

Infantry: Fast operators against infantry and light machines; weak against heavy armor. Capture relays and recover at an operator hub.
步兵: 高速操作员，擅长对抗步兵与轻型机械，对重甲较弱。可占领中继站并在操作员中枢恢复。

Infantry: Fast frontline skimmer with a ground-only cannon and less hull strength than Bastion armor. Use mobility and repair support.
步兵: 高速前线悬浮战车，主炮仅攻击地面。车体强度低于堡垒装甲，需要发挥机动性并获得维修支援。

Infantry: Precision: 12 m anti-armor lance, 0.75 s charge; weak against infantry. Interception: full air damage, 33% ground damage (100% with Dual-purpose AA). Switching disables fire for 2 s.
步兵: 精确模式：12 米反装甲光矛，蓄力 0.75 秒，对步兵较弱。拦截模式：对空全额伤害，对地 33% 伤害，研究两用防空后对地提升至 100%。切换时停火 2 秒。

Infantry: 14 m ground-only precision fire. Deploys while stationary for 1.5 s; each shot charges for 0.75 s. Moving retracts supports.
步兵: 射程 14 米的精确对地火力。静止 1.5 秒展开，每发蓄力 0.75 秒。移动会收起支架。

Infantry: Fast, unarmed scout with extended vision. Reveal routes and defenses before committing your army.
步兵: 高速无武装侦察机，视野广阔。在大军推进前侦察路线与防御。

Infantry: Fast strike aircraft for ground raids and air combat. Avoid dedicated anti-air and return to a flight deck for service.
步兵: 高速攻击机，用于对地突袭与空战。避开专职防空，返回飞行平台维修。

Infantry: Produces Mule engineers, receives harvested resources and supplies 8 power.
步兵: 生产骡式工程机，接收采集资源并提供 8 电力。

Infantry: Repairs one mechanical ground ally or completed building at a time. 3 m reach, measured from a building's edge.
步兵: 同时维修一个地面机械友军或已完工建筑。范围 3 米，从建筑边缘计算。

步兵: 请先完成或取消当前研究。

Infantry: Combat units deal +%d%% weapon damage. Applies to existing and new infantry, armor, walkers and strike aircraft.
步兵: 战斗单位武器伤害提升 %d%%，适用于现有及新生产的步兵、装甲、步行机甲与攻击机。

Infantry: Combat units gain +%d%% maximum HP. Existing units keep their health percentage; engineers, support and buildings are unchanged.
步兵: 战斗单位最大生命值提升 %d%%。现有单位保持生命比例；工程师、支援单位与建筑不变。

Infantry: Repair robots, depots, barracks and airfields restore health 25% faster. Service range and capacity stay the same.
步兵: 维修机器人、维修站、兵营和机场的恢复速度提升 25%，范围与容量不变。

Infantry: Anchor reduces incoming damage by 25% instead of 15%. Hold still for 2 seconds inside its sector; movement still breaks Anchor.
步兵: 锚定伤害减免从 15% 提升至 25%。需在区域内静止 2 秒，移动仍会解除锚定。

Infantry: Precision Window cuts the first shot's preparation time by 50% instead of 20%. Its duration, cooldown, damage and reload stay the same.
步兵: 精确窗口将首发蓄力时间缩短 50%（原为 20%）。持续时间、冷却、伤害与装填不变。

Infantry: Mobile, lightly protected ground cannon. Use flanks and withdraw for repairs.
步兵: 轻防护机动地面火炮。利用侧翼，及时撤退维修。

Infantry: Fast shotgun shock troops. Rapid bursts decimate light infantry at close quarters. Weak against vehicles.
步兵: 装备霰弹枪的高速突击步兵。近距离快速连发可重创轻步兵。对车辆较弱。

Infantry: Field-modified twin-missile hunter. Excellent burst deterrence against charging vehicles.
步兵: 野战改装的双联导弹猎手。对突进的装甲车辆具有极佳的爆发威慑力。

Infantry: Rugged long-range marksman. Spotting lens pierces camouflage and neutralizes exposed infantry.
步兵: 顽强的远距离神射手。瞄准镜可穿透伪装并消灭暴露的步兵。

Infantry: Lightly armored fast raiding vehicle armed with high-cadence twin autocannons. Ideal for flanking armor.
步兵: 装备高射速双联机炮的轻装甲高速突袭战车。非常适合侧翼绕袭装甲部队。

Infantry: Equipped with pulse blasters and shielding. Discharges concentrated arc volleys against clustered infantry.
步兵: 装备脉冲爆能枪与护盾。向密集的步兵发射密集的电弧齐射。

Infantry: Discharges focused ion payload that drains plasma barriers and weakens heavy vehicle drives.
步兵: 发射聚集离子弹头，瓦解等离子护盾并削弱重型车辆动力。

Infantry: High-powered phase needle rifle with enhanced optic sensors. Pierces frontline units from extreme range.
步兵: 配备增强光学传感器的强力相位针刺步枪。可在极远距离穿透前线单位。

Infantry: Nimble skimmer armed with a high-velocity pulse laser cannon. Floats across terrain with unmatched mobility.
步兵: 装备高速脉冲激光炮的敏捷悬浮战车。以无与伦比的机动性在地形上滑行。

Infantry: Heavy tracked anchor with hardened frontal armor and a heavy 90mm cannon. Anchors battle lines against enemy advances.
步兵: 配备强化正面装甲和 90 毫米重炮的重型履带铁锚。构筑战线抵御敌军推进。

Infantry: Heavy combat shotgun vanguard with deployable Shield Wall. Absorbs frontline punishment and suppresses light infantry.
步兵: 配备部署式护盾之墙的重型霰弹先锋。可承受前线猛攻并压制轻步兵。

Infantry: Long-range mercenary scout armed with spotter Target Flares. Reveals fog and coordinates heavy strikes.
步兵: 配备侦察照明弹的远程佣兵侦察兵。可驱散战争迷雾并协调重型打击。

Infantry: Armored shock trooper equipped with anti-armor EMP disruptor rockets. Stuns electronics and breaks tank pushes.
步兵: 配备反装甲电磁干扰火箭的装甲突击兵。可瘫痪电子设备并粉碎坦克冲锋。

Infantry: Deploy heavy kinetic barrier. Grants 40% damage resistance and suppression immunity, but reduces movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds.
步兵: 部署重型动能屏障。获得 40% 伤害减免与压制免疫，但降低 30% 移速，持续 6 秒。
